title: Operational runway failover drill: synthetic load shedding, circuit-breaker calibration, and snapshot consistency checks
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Purpose: Validate an operational runway for an active->passive promotion in a controlled, scheduled failover drill that combines synthetic traffic, SLO-aware load shedding, and end-to-end backup/restore integrity checks. This ticket codifies the drill plan, automation orchestration, observability checks, and rollback criteria so on-call and SRE teams can execute the exercise with predictable outcomes. Scope: multi-region active/passive switch for inference control plane and tokenstore KV in a non-customer-facing staging region that mirrors production traffic patterns and data volumes. Excludes database schema migrations and long-running data backfills.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic traffic generator reproduces P50/P95/P99 latency and request mix (chat/generation/embeddings) for target workload within 10% of production profile
Passive region promotion completes without total request loss; at most 1% 5m error spike above baseline and recovery to SLO levels within 15 minutes
KV snapshot checksums match between pre-drill snapshot and post-restore snapshot (bitwise comparison) for sampled keys representing hot and cold partitions
Circuit-breaker configuration exercised: 3 threshold levels validated (conservative, default, aggressive) and automated rollback triggers fire when thresholds breached
Automated canary traffic shows no semantic regressions for 95% of sampled prompt/eval pairs; any regression triggers immediate rollback
Runbook automation creates an artifacts bundle (logs, metrics, snapshots, synthetic traffic traces, and restore reports) that is uploaded to the incident bucket within 30 minutes of drill completion
checklist: Pre-drill: confirm snapshot cadence and retention for target KV partitions
Pre-drill: validate that synthetic traffic config matches recent 7-day production histograms
Pre-drill: notify stakeholders (SRE, PM, Support, Customer Success) and schedule a 60-minute post-drill review
Pre-drill: set circuit-breaker dry-run flags and ensure feature-flag gate exists for quick disable
Pre-drill: warm passive region caches using warmup playbook (kv-warmup-v2)
runbook_steps: T-minus 60m: Confirm runbook leads and run channel (#drills-run) are present and pagers aware
T-minus 30m: Take a fresh KV snapshot (snapshot-manifest v{date}) and store checksum in artifacts bucket
T-minus 20m: Start synthetic traffic generator (synth-gen v1.9) against active region in shaped mode; ramp to target QPS over 10m
T-minus 10m: Enable circuit-breaker tier 'conservative' for non-essential routes; observe baseline error and latency metrics
T0: Flip routing flag to route 0% -> 100% traffic to passive region using progressive steps (10%, 30%, 60%, 100%) with 2m stabilization windows
During ramp: monitor key SLO dashboards: request_latency_p50/p95/p99, error_rate_5m, tokens_per_sec, kv_restore_lag
At each step: run integrity probe (sampled kv-check-tool) that verifies 100 random hot keys and 100 cold keys; if mismatch, hit rollback
Post-promotion: trigger background restore validator to replay WAL for last 30m of writes and assert eventual consistency within 5m
Post-mortem: collect artifacts and run automated checksum comparator; annotate results and file follow-up action items
rollback_criteria: Sustained error_rate_5m > 1.5x baseline OR absolute error_rate_5m > 3% for 5 continuous minutes
P99 latency > 2x baseline for 10 continuous minutes
KV integrity probe finds any bitwise mismatch in sampled keys
Canary eval semantic failures exceed 5% on sampled prompts
Synthetic traffic generator fails to maintain expected QPS for 3 consecutive stabilization windows
dashboards_and_queries: DR Control Dashboard: runtime_failover_control.summary (shows promotion percentage, latest snapshot id, restore status)
SLO Healthboard: slo_overview.per_route (P50/P95/P99 + error budgets remaining)
Synthetic traffic traces: synth_traces.latency_histograms and synth_traces.request_mix_breakdown
synthetic_traffic_profiles: profile-small-chat: 60% short-chat, 30% embeddings, 10% rerank; target 200 qps; token distribution matched to prod-7d
profile-heavy-gen: 40% long-form generation, 40% chat, 20% embeddings; target 60 qps; average seq_len=1024
profile-burst: intermittent spikes to 5x baseline for 30s every 10m to validate autoscale and circuit-breaker behavior
post_drill_validation: Aggregate latency and error graphs show return to baseline within 15 minutes of completing reroute
KV checksum comparator returns 0 mismatches for sampled partitions OR identifies deterministic root cause for any mismatch
Cost telemetry shows expected transient increase in token and egress costs and is within approved drill budget
All automated rollback triggers behaved as expected during simulation tests prior to run
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Passive region resource starvation during warmup; Mitigation: pre-reserve burst capacity and validate GPU allocations via capacity-checker
Risk: Synthetic traffic generator misconfig mismatch; Mitigation: run three dry runs at -48h, -24h, -2h and compare histograms
Risk: False-positive checksum due to sampling bias; Mitigation: diversified sampling (hot/cold/shard-aware) and increase sample size on suspicion
Risk: Rollback takes longer than expected and increases SLO exposure; Mitigation: pre-validate rollback path in staging and ensure automated route toggles are tested
automation_and_tools: playbook-runner v0.8 (orchestrates routing flips, snapshot capture, and synthetic traffic) - repo: github.com/redwood/playbook-runner
kv-check-tool v2 (parallel checksum compare and sample reconciler) - repo: github.com/redwood/kv-tools
synth-gen v1.9 (traffic generator with semantic eval hooks) - config stored in s3://rw-dr/synth-configs/2026
dr-artifacts-uploader (bundles logs/metrics/snapshots and pushes to GCS)
communications_plan: 72h: Announcement to affected teams and scheduled maintenance calendar entry
24h: Reminder to stakeholders with precise window and expected impact
T-minus 15m: Final confirmation in #drills-run and open conference bridge
Post-drill +30m: Summary message with immediate findings and link to artifacts
Post-drill +48h: Detailed postmortem and follow-up action tracker
